title: Noam Chomsky - The Crimes of U.S. Presidents
summary: A short clip, from 2003, of Noam Chomsky going through crimes of post-WW2 US presidents. He argues that they would be indictable under the Nuremberg principles.
why: HN links it as the source for the claim that every post-war president would be indictable under Nuremberg standards.

quote.text: If the Nuremberg principles were applied, every post-World War 2 president would be indictable.
